## Question

How does a giant session file — 27 MB measured, from anywhere: Claude, Claude Code (base64 images), Hermes (no fixed shape) — get ingested whole, when the live capture adapter must never grow the machinery to do it?

The answer is a **second application**, built from the live adapter's parts. It is charted here as the wayfinder task that resolves it.

**Operator rulings — the contract for this ticket** (`_plans/python-port-sequence.md` §TWO APPLICATIONS, lines 159-194):

- **Two distinct applications, not one.** Operator, 2026-07-31, after catching a format factory being designed into the live hook path: *"those are distinctly different applications."* The live adapter (`apps/capture/`) sits inside Claude Code / Code / Pi replacing the MCP Open Brain; it is triggered by a `Stop` hook once per turn, reads watermark→EOF (a few KB), has a **hard 5-second deadline**, sees exactly **ONE** format, and must never block the session. The bulk ingester is a **separate app that sucks in giant session files from anywhere**; **an operator runs it, rarely**; it reads a **whole file** (27 MB measured); it has **no deadline**; the watermark is **irrelevant — it wants everything**; it handles **many formats**; and on failure it **may retry, quarantine, resume**.

- **The live adapter must never see any of this.** No format factory, no whole-file read, no bulk staging, no Hermes on the deadline-critical path. *"A hook attached to one harness only ever sees that harness's format, so format dispatch on the deadline-critical path is complexity for a case that cannot occur."*

- **The bulk ingester REUSES the live ingester's parts.** Operator: *"reuse already working code, good."* `records.py` and the four `signal.py` modules are **pure functions over a line or a string, with no I/O and no state**, so the bulk app **imports them directly** and adds only its own format adapters — it does not copy them.

- **The format factory keyed on input type belongs HERE, not in the live adapter.** *"The factory keyed on input type belongs THERE."* This split already exists in the TypeScript being ported: `scripts/backfill-transcripts.ts` is a separate script, not a mode of the hook.

- **SQLite staging store — decided 2026-07-31 02:15, recorded the same day** (`_plans/python-port-sequence.md` lines 189-194): the bulk ingester may load the whole giant file into SQLite and yield each turn to its caller. Operator: *"big file goes in, SQLite... rejiggers it into the proper manner and then pops off and yields each output."* This belongs to the BULK app only; the live adapter never stages. The measurement that forces it: `read_since(27.4 MB, offset=0)` peaked at **+90 MB RSS to extract 85 KB** of operator text — a ~1000x amplification (`_plans/python-port-sequence.md` line 231).

- **Writes route through the finished client, never a rebuilt path** (`_plans/python-port-sequence.md` §THE WRITE PATH ALREADY EXISTS, lines 198-229): whole turns go through `AgentMemory.ingest_raw_turns` (RAW lane); classified events through `append_event` (DISTILLED lane). Nothing in `python/openbrain/` talks to Postgres or HTTP directly — *"a second implementation is a defect on sight."* The bulk app never touches the live adapter's watermark or hook path.

- **No caps, no truncation, no bounds** — recall is total (`docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md:160`; a number in a test is an INPUT SIZE).

**Constraints for the build:** a SEPARATE app (new module under `python/openbrain`, e.g. `apps/bulk/`, following the existing `apps/` layout); imports `records.py` + `signal.py` functions directly as pure functions (no I/O, no copy); stages the whole file into SQLite and **yields** each turn to the caller; writes ONLY through the `openbrain-memory` client; format adapters keyed on input type live HERE — **Claude transcript format first**; Code (base64 images) and Hermes (no fixed shape) are **follow-on tickets**. Console-script entry per the existing `[project.scripts]` pattern. Operator-run: loud errors, may retry / quarantine / resume — never silent.

**Plan of record:** `_plans/python-port-sequence.md` §TWO APPLICATIONS (lines 159-194) and §THE WRITE PATH ALREADY EXISTS (lines 198-229). Standing rulings: `_plans/rewrite-gotchas.md`.

Type: task (AFK). This map carries execution (#443 Notes): the resolution builds the Claude-format bulk ingester and posts the receipt here.

## Resolution — RUNNING (gates + live round-trip proven this session)

Built the bulk ingester as the second application. Commit `d51cf56` on
`rewrite/420-settings-cutover`.

### What was built

A SEPARATE app at `python/openbrain/src/openbrain/apps/bulk/`, following the
existing `apps/` layout, `apps/capture/` and `apps/hooks/` untouched:

- **`formats.py`** — the format factory keyed on input type (`InputFormat`
  enum). The Claude adapter IS `records.raw_turn_from_line`, imported (reuse by
  import, not copy). Code (base64 images) and Hermes (no fixed shape) are
  registered as loud placeholders that raise `FormatNotImplementedError` on
  selection — the follow-on tickets, named in the ticket body.
- **`staging.py`** — the SQLite staging store (decided 2026-07-31 02:15). Whole
  file in, rejiggered into ordered `RawTurn` rows; `pending()` streams each turn
  back; `mark_sent` gives resume, `quarantine` gives the operator failure mode.
- **`ingest.py`** — the bulk spine: `stage_file` (whole file → store via the
  format adapter, streamed) then `ingest` (yield each pending turn to a
  `BulkLane`, mark sent or quarantine). One turn per send so a single rejection
  doesn't fail the remainder.
- **`run.py`** — console entry `openbrain-bulk-ingest`. Builds the real
  `openbrain_memory` client WITHOUT the live path's 5s deadline/single-attempt
  pins (bulk has no deadline, may retry). Loud: non-zero exit on a partial
  ingest.

- **SEPARATE app, new module under `python/openbrain`** — MET. `apps/bulk/`;
  `apps/capture/` and `apps/hooks/` carry zero bulk code (verified: no new
